description: Create a new note from markdown. The first line becomes the title. Tags are auto-detected from #hashtags in the content (including hierarchical #parent/child and multi-word tags written with a closing hash: #my project#) — no separate tag tools needed. Reuse the user's existing tags: call list_tags first and match an existing handle exactly (same casing and hierarchy), e.g. write #todo rather than coining #todos or #task when #todo already exists. Only invent a new hashtag when no existing tag fits; if you're unsure which tag the user wants, ask them instead of guessing. Link to another note by writing [[Note Title]] with the exact title of an existing note — the server resolves it into a real note link (clickable in the apps, counted in backlinks). Titles that don't match an existing note stay as plain text.

content.description: Note content in markdown. Title derives from the first line. Use #hashtags to tag the note (close multi-word tags with a second hash: #my project#).

name: create_note

note.description: The affected note, with contentPreview rather than the full body. Call get_note to read it back.

archivedAt.description: Set only while the note is archived.

contentPreview.description: Markdown flattened to one line and clipped to ~200 chars. Call get_note for the full body.

deletedAt.description: Set only while the note is in trash.

tags.description: Present on detail, create and update responses. Omitted when empty.
